jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Deadline for applications: 7th August 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As a Senior Engineer/Senior R&D Specialist Systems Innovation at Nestlé NPTC, your mission is to lead research and early-stage innovation for new coffee systems, from idea generation and concept design to pre-development and know-how transfer. A coffee system combines the machine, the beverage ingredients (e.g., capsule, pod, or sachet), and the preparation process to create a unique consumer experience.

You’ll work closely with business partners, primarily Nespresso and Nescafé Dolce Gusto, as well as operations, research and development teams, suppliers, universities, and technology partners. Whether your passion is microengineering, mechatronics, machine design, or connected products, you will have the opportunity to explore new technologies, turn ideas into prototypes, grow your expertise, and help shape the next generation of coffee experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers around the world.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Engineer/Senior R&D Specialist Systems Innovation

• Leading research projects and early-stage innovation behind the next generation of Nespresso and Nescafé Dolce Gusto systems.

• Driving the development of technical components, subsystems and system building blocks that support future beverage experiences.

• Identifying technology trends, competitor developments and consumer insights to shape a strong innovation pipeline.

• Turn ideas into reality through rapid prototyping, testing, experimentation, and technology exploration, and validate new solutions for machines, capsules, products and preparation methods.

• Coordinating internal and external partners to deliver projects on time, within budget and in line with quality, safety and compliance expectations.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in machine design, system performance, machine intelligence, components, materials and quality by design.

• Bringing strong expertise in embedded systems (hardware and software development), inter-connected devices, signal processing and data acquisition for systems.

• Using prototyping (in mechanics and electronics), computer-aided design, simulations and testing methods to create, assess and refine innovative technical concepts.

• Collaborating with confidence across functions, suppliers and business partners while managing priorities, timelines, risks and project costs.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Company: Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Target start date: February 2027, flexible
Activity rate: 100%
Deadline for applications: 19 October, 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

The Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee is a global center of expertise for coffee and beverage innovation. Our teams in Konolfingen, Orbe, Singapore and Marysville lead coffee and beverage research and development for Nestlé markets worldwide.

As a R&D Intern – Powder Structure and Performance, you will join a six-month project focused on the materials science of multicomponent powders. You will help the team investigate how compositional factors, including lipid and protein content, affect powder structure, dissolution and flowability, combining experimental characterization with quantitative data analysis to develop scientifically grounded composition–property relationships. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a R&D Intern – Powder Structure and Performance

• Review literature on multicomponent powders, interfacial phenomena and composition - structure - property relationships.

• Define testable hypotheses linking lipid and protein composition to powder behaviour.

• Design and conduct controlled experiments using relevant compositional, physicochemical and functional measurements.

• Characterize powder dissolution and flowability using reproducible quantitative methods.

• Apply statistical and graphical analysis to identify correlations, trends and governing parameters.

• Interpret the results mechanistically and communicate conclusions through a technical report and presentation.

What will make you successful

• Being a student or fresh graduate in Materials Science, Food Science, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Chemistry or a related scientific field.

• Good understanding of powder behaviour, transport phenomena, interfacial science or physical and chemical characterization.

• Being curious, rigorous and hands-on, with enthusiasm for laboratory work, experimental design and developing new approaches to scientific questions.

• Having strong quantitative analysis and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with varied technical partners.

• Communicating fluently in English; French is an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

In qualità di R&D Intern – Powder Structure and Performance, ti unirai a un progetto di sei mesi focalizzato sulla scienza dei materiali delle polveri multicomponenti. Aiuterai il team a indagare su come i fattori compositivi, tra cui il contenuto di lipidi e proteine, colpiranno la struttura della polvere, la dissoluzione e la fluidità, combinando la caratterizzazione sperimentale con l'analisi quantitativa dei dati per sviluppare relazioni compositive-property scientificamente fondate. • Rassegna letteratura su polveri multicomponenti, fenomeni interfacciali e composizione - struttura - relazioni di proprietà.

• Definire ipotesi testabili che collegano la composizione di lipidi e proteine al comportamento della polvere.

• Progettare e condurre esperimenti controllati utilizzando misure compositive, fisicochimiche e funzionali rilevanti.

• Caratterizzare la dissoluzione della polvere e la fluidità utilizzando metodi quantitativi riproducibili.

• Applicare analisi statistiche e grafiche per identificare correlazioni, tendenze e parametri di governo.

• Interpretare i risultati in modo meccanico e comunicare le conclusioni attraverso un rapporto tecnico e una presentazione.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Buona comprensione del comportamento della polvere, dei fenomeni di trasporto, della scienza interfacciale o della caratterizzazione fisica e chimica.

• Essere curiosi, rigorosi e pratici, con entusiasmo per il lavoro di laboratorio, il design sperimentale e lo sviluppo di nuovi approcci alle questioni scientifiche.

• Avendo forti capacità di analisi e comunicazione quantitativa, con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborare con vari partner tecnici.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; il francese è un vantaggio.

• Dimostrando coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer papierbasierter Verpackungslösungen für Kaffeeprodukte, einschließlich flexibler und starrer Formate.

• Der Beitrag zum Verpackungsmaterial ändert sich von Kunststoff zu Papier und trägt gleichzeitig dazu bei, Funktionalität, Qualität und Verbrauchererfahrung zu erhalten.

• Master-Absolvent in Verpackungstechnik, Materialwissenschaft, Industriedesign oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit einem starken Interesse an Verpackungsinnovation.

• Mit starken Kooperations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit dem Vertrauen, mit Labors, Projektteams, Geschäftspartnern und Lieferanten zusammenzuarbeiten.

• fließend Englisch; Französisch ist ein Asset.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and delight consumers through coffee and beverage innovation

As an R&D Specialist for System Science at Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee , your mission is to build the scientific foundations needed to explain, optimize and predict product, machine and packaging system performance. Our teams in Orbe, Konolfingen, Singapore and Marysville lead coffee and beverage R&D for Nestlé markets worldwide. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with system performance specialists, product developers, engineers and multidisciplinary research teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale. This is your opportunity to drive cutting-edge innovation, strengthen your expertise and deliver meaningful results to create unique consumer experiences at global scale.

How you’ll make an impact as an &D Specialist - System Science

• Formulating hypotheses that connect product, machine and packaging design choices with beverage performance.

• Designing experiments that reveal flow, pressure, mass transfer, extraction, dissolution and foam generation mechanisms.

• Building predictive, physics-based models that explain system behaviour and guide technical decisions.

• Identifying performance drivers, variability and knowledge gaps to improve system robustness and optimization.

• Creating reusable scientific knowledge that accelerates future research, product development and system innovation.

• Translating scientific findings into clear recommendations for technical integration, validation and performance improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of physical chemistry, applied physics, mechanical engineering or a related scientific field.

• Applying predictive modelling to explain system behaviour, test design choices and anticipate performance.

• Using expertise in transport phenomena, fluid systems, experimentation and packaging to solve complex system challenges.

• Connecting fundamental science with system design questions and communicating clearly across multidisciplinary teams.

• Communicating fluently in English and translating complex scientific concepts into clear, engaging messages.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé Switzerland, we care about our people.

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Healthcare contribution and Employee Assistance Program for you and your family

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Performance based bonus

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your skills

• Attractive employee discounts across everyday products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Seien Sie eine Kraft für das Gute und die Freude der Verbraucher durch Kaffee und Getränke Innovation

Soyez une force pour le bien et ravir les consommateurs grâce à l'innovation du café et des boissons

En tant que spécialiste en R-D pour la science des systèmes au Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee , votre mission est de construire les bases scientifiques nécessaires pour expliquer, optimiser et prédire les performances des produits, des machines et des systèmes d'emballage. Nos équipes à Orbe, Konolfingen, Singapour et Marysville mènent la R-D sur le café et les boissons pour les marchés de Nestlé dans le monde entier. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les spécialistes de la performance du système, les développeurs de produits, les ingénieurs et les équipes de recherche multidisciplinaires. C'est l'occasion pour vous de prendre en main, de développer votre expertise et de produire des résultats significatifs qui font la différence à l'échelle. C'est l'occasion de stimuler l'innovation de pointe, de renforcer votre expertise et de produire des résultats significatifs pour créer des expériences uniques des consommateurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste & D - System Science

• Formuler des hypothèses qui relient les choix de conception des produits, des machines et des emballages à la performance des boissons.

• Concevoir des expériences qui révèlent le débit, la pression, le transfert de masse, l'extraction, la dissolution et les mécanismes de production de mousse.

• Établir des modèles prédictifs fondés sur la physique qui expliquent le comportement du système et guident les décisions techniques.

• Identifier les facteurs de performance, la variabilité et les lacunes de connaissances pour améliorer la robustesse et l'optimisation du système.

• Créer des connaissances scientifiques réutilisables qui accélèrent la recherche future, le développement de produits et l'innovation des systèmes.

• Appliquer la modélisation prédictive pour expliquer le comportement du système, tester les choix de conception et anticiper les performances.

• Utilisation de l'expertise dans les phénomènes de transport, les systèmes fluides, l'expérimentation et l'emballage pour résoudre les défis complexes du système.

• Relier la science fondamentale aux questions de conception du système et communiquer clairement entre les équipes multidisciplinaires.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais et traduire des concepts scientifiques complexes en messages clairs et engageants.

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As an IP Paralegal at Nestlé, your mission is to support Senior Legal Counsels responsible for trademark portfolios and to independently drive intellectual property projects. To support one of our newly integrated Strategic Business Unit, you will play a key role in ensuring strong portfolio management, efficient ways of working and close collaboration with internal business and legal stakeholders. You will make a difference by helping protect and strengthen Nestlé’s brands through accurate trademark searches, portfolio management and legal research.

How you’ll make an impact as an IP Paralegal

• Conducting trademark availability searches, analysing results and making clear recommendations to the responsible Counsel(s).

• Managing trademark and industrial design registration processes from filing to grant for specific Business Unit(s), aligned with business roll-out plans.

• Handling objections from IP Authorities, defensive oppositions and related agreements, undertakings and co-existence terms.

• Monitoring competitive trademark publications, supporting oppositions where needed and drafting reports on moderately complex legal matters.

• Keeping internal records accurate by creating and updating files, docketing deadlines and monitoring key portfolio milestones.

• Supporting legal research, evidence gathering and litigation activities by organising information, sales figures and marketing materials for trademark and design matters.

What will make you successful

• Bringing solid experience in trademarks within an international environment or a law firm.

• Working confidently with online databases and web-based IP management systems, ideally Memotech, or showing strong digital agility to onboard quickly.

• Combining excellent planning and organisational skills with strong accuracy and attention to detail.

• Being flexible, proactive and collaborative, with the curiosity and agility to work autonomously and take initiative.

• Being curious about innovation and comfortable working with digital tools, data analytics and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, to help drive operational excellence and support the future development of our IP services.

• Communicating fluently in written and spoken English; good spoken French is desirable.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way across different brands, businesses, functions and regions.

• Flexible working arrangements that facilitate creativity and collaboration.

• A culture of respect, with diversity, equity and inclusion at its core.

• A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop and grow.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Per supportare una delle nostre nuove unità strategiche di business integrate, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire una gestione forte del portafoglio, modi efficienti di lavorare e una stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni e legali. Farete la differenza aiutando a proteggere e rafforzare i marchi di Nestlé attraverso accurate ricerche di marchi, gestione del portafoglio e ricerca legale.

Come farete un impatto come un IP Paralegal

• Condurre le ricerche sulla disponibilità del marchio, analizzare i risultati e formulare raccomandazioni chiare al Consiglio(i) responsabile.

• Gestione dei processi di registrazione del marchio e del design industriale dal deposito alla concessione di specifiche unità aziendali, allineati con piani di roll-out aziendali.

• Gestire obiezioni da parte delle autorità IP, delle opposizioni difensive e dei relativi accordi, delle imprese e dei termini di coesistenza.

• Monitoraggio delle pubblicazioni dei marchi concorrenziali, sostegno alle opposizioni ove necessario e redazione di relazioni su questioni giuridiche moderatamente complesse.

• Mantenere i record interni accurati creando e aggiornando i file, le scadenze di docketing e il monitoraggio delle tappe chiave del portafoglio.

• Sostenere le attività legali di ricerca, raccolta di prove e contenzioso organizzando informazioni, cifre di vendita e materiali di marketing per le questioni di marchi e design.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare solida esperienza nei marchi all'interno di un ambiente internazionale o uno studio legale.

• Lavorare con fiducia con database online e sistemi di gestione IP basati sul web, idealmente Memotech, o mostrare una forte agilità digitale a bordo rapidamente.

• Combinando eccellenti capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione con una forte precisione e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Essendo flessibile, proattivo e collaborativo, con la curiosità e l'agilità di lavorare autonomamente e prendere iniziativa.

• Essere curiosi dell'innovazione e del lavoro confortevole con strumenti digitali, analisi dei dati e tecnologie emergenti, comprese le soluzioni AI-enabled, per aiutare a guidare l'eccellenza operativa e sostenere lo sviluppo futuro dei nostri servizi IP.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese scritto e parlato; buon francese parlato è auspicabile.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

A Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Eccitanti opportunità per sviluppare la tua carriera il tuo senso attraverso diversi marchi, aziende, funzioni e regioni.

• Disposizioni di lavoro flessibili che facilitano la creatività e la collaborazione.

• Una cultura del rispetto, con diversità, equità e inclusione al suo centro.

• Un ambiente dinamico internazionale che ti consente di imparare, sviluppare e crescere.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Il reclutamento sarà guidato dalla misura tra le singole competenze e i requisiti del ruolo. Ogni candidato le cui competenze corrispondono alle esigenze del lavoro sarà considerato. Se avete bisogno di un adattamento durante il processo di reclutamento, fateci sapere in modo da potervi sostenere efficacemente. Tutte le informazioni saranno trattate con riservatezza.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Digital Process Design Engineer at Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health, your mission is to develop, standardize and govern process engineering drawings and digital plant models that enable safe, efficient and reusable solutions for nutrition industrialization projects. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with process and automation engineers, project managers, factory teams and equipment suppliers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Process Design Engineer

• Developing accurate process diagrams, equipment layouts and three-dimensional plant models that turn engineering concepts into implementation-ready designs.

• Standardizing modular design components, drawing libraries and templates to improve quality, consistency and reuse across global projects.

• Reviewing supplier drawings and digital models to identify clashes and strengthen safety, hygiene, operability, maintainability and accessibility.

• Delivering basic engineering solutions for defined process units, including layouts, equipment interfaces, utility needs and technical specifications.

• Managing engineering data and synchronized digital plant information so teams can find, trust and use current documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Driving continuous improvement in design workflows and standards while sharing practical drafting knowledge with engineers, factories and suppliers.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong two-dimensional and three-dimensional drafting capability for process plants, equipment layouts and engineering documentation.

• Applying computer-aided design tools, ideally including AutoCAD, Plant 3D and Inventor, to create precise and reusable design solutions.

• Using knowledge of process equipment, piping, utilities, instrumentation and hygienic design to strengthen safe and practical layouts.

• Collaborating proactively with engineers, factory partners and suppliers while managing engineering data, revisions and document standards with care.

• Communicating confidently in English at a good working level.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta

In qualità di Digital Process Design Engineer presso Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health, la vostra missione è quella di sviluppare, standardizzare e governare i disegni di ingegneria dei processi e i modelli di impianti digitali che consentono soluzioni sicure, efficienti e riutilizzabili per i progetti di industrializzazione della nutrizione. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con ingegneri di processo e automazione, project manager, team di fabbrica e fornitori di attrezzature. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fornire risultati significativi che fanno la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come un Digital Process Design Engineer

• Sviluppare diagrammi di processo accurati, layout di attrezzature e modelli di impianti tridimensionali che trasformano i concetti di ingegneria in progetti pronti all'implementazione.

• Standardizzare componenti di design modulari, disegnare librerie e modelli per migliorare la qualità, la consistenza e il riutilizzo in progetti globali.

• Rivedere disegni dei fornitori e modelli digitali per identificare gli scontri e rafforzare la sicurezza, l'igiene, l'operabilità, la manutenbilità e l'accessibilità.

• Fornire soluzioni di ingegneria di base per unità di processo definite, tra cui layout, interfacce di attrezzature, esigenze di utilità e specifiche tecniche.

• Gestione dei dati di ingegneria e sincronizzazione delle informazioni sugli impianti digitali in modo che i team possano trovare, fidarsi e utilizzare la documentazione corrente durante il ciclo di vita del progetto.

• Miglioramento continuo dei flussi di lavoro e degli standard di progettazione, condividendo le conoscenze pratiche di redazione con ingegneri, fabbriche e fornitori.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte capacità di redazione bidimensionale e tridimensionale per impianti di processo, layout di attrezzature e documentazione ingegneristica.

• Applicando strumenti di progettazione assistiti da computer, tra cui AutoCAD, Plant 3D e Inventor, per creare soluzioni di design precise e riutilizzabili.

• Utilizzando la conoscenza di apparecchiature di processo, tubazioni, utilità, strumentazione e progettazione igienica per rafforzare layout sicuri e pratici.

• Collaborare in modo proattivo con ingegneri, partner di fabbrica e fornitori, mentre gestisco dati di ingegneria, revisioni e standard di documento con cura.

• Comunicare con fiducia in inglese ad un buon livello di lavoro.

• Dimostrando coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora le vite e il pianeta.

As a Patent Counsel in Digital & AI, your mission is to enable and protect Nestlé’s digital, AI-driven and electronics-centric innovations through pragmatic legal services and business-driven IP protection. You will act as the go-to Legal R&D partner for Digital & AI topics across the Nestlé R&D ecosystem, collaborating closely with R&D teams, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts. This is your opportunity to shape and grow the IP strategy for one of Nestlé’s most strategic innovation frontiers.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Digital & AI

• Develop and deliver the IP strategy for digital, AI and electronics-driven innovations, in close partnership with R&D teams, the patent team, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts.

• Lead business-driven patent filing and prosecution, Freedom-to-Operate assessments, oppositions of third-party patents and defense against third-party oppositions.

• Manage your patent portfolio with strong business alignment and rigorous cost management.

• Advise on IP matters in R&D collaborations, including Digital & AI partnerships, licensing and joint developments.

• Support Coffee & Systems and other categories on connected systems, digital platforms and AI-based innovations, in collaboration with category Patent Counsels.

• Partner with Nestlé Research, the Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional and other R&D centers to protect digital and AI innovations across categories.

• Promote passion for IP through awareness sessions, training and communication, while contributing to the awareness and enforcement of Nestlé patents in R&D and in the markets.

• Fully qualified patent attorney, European Patent Attorney (EQE) and/or national qualification in a major jurisdiction such as the USA, with a background in Electronics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI or a related engineering discipline.

• Proven experience in digital, AI and/or electronics-related IP projects, ideally including software-implemented inventions, AI/ML, connected devices and computer-implemented business methods.

Potrai fungere da partner R&D legale per temi Digital & AI in tutto l'ecosistema Nestlé R&D, collaborando a stretto contatto con i team R&D, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels e IP Analysts. Questa è la vostra opportunità di plasmare e far crescere la strategia IP per una delle frontiere più strategiche dell’innovazione di Nestlé.

Come farai un impatto come consulente brevetti – Digital & AI

• Sviluppare e fornire la strategia IP per le innovazioni digitali, AI e electronics-driven, in stretta collaborazione con i team R&D, il team di brevetti, i consulenti R&D e gli analisti IP.

• Leader business-driven brevettt deposito e persecuzione, valutazioni Freedom-to-Operate, opposizione di brevetti di terze parti e difesa contro opposizioni di terzi.

• Gestisci il tuo portafoglio brevetti con un forte allineamento aziendale e una rigorosa gestione dei costi.

• Consigli sulle questioni IP nelle collaborazioni R&D, tra cui le partnership Digital & AI, le licenze e gli sviluppi congiunti.

• Support Coffee & Systems e altre categorie su sistemi collegati, piattaforme digitali e innovazioni basate su AI, in collaborazione con i consulenti di brevetti di categoria.

• Partner di Nestlé Research, Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional e altri centri R&D per proteggere le innovazioni digitali e AI in tutte le categorie.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Procuratore di brevetti completamente qualificato, Avvocato europeo dei brevetti (EQE) e / o qualifica nazionale in una giurisdizione principale come gli Stati Uniti, con un background in Elettronica, Scienza informatica, Ingegneria del software, Scienza dei dati, AI o una disciplina di ingegneria correlata.

• Esperienza dimostrata nei progetti IP digitali, AI e/o relativi all'elettronica, idealmente compresi invenzioni implementate dal software, AI/ML, dispositivi connessi e metodi di business implementati dal computer.

• Più di 3 anni di esperienza post-qualificazione con la redazione di brevetti, la prosecuzione e le valutazioni Freedom-to-Operate nello spazio digitale, elettronico o AI.

• Sperimenta lo sviluppo di strategie IP business-driven in più giurisdizioni, con una solida comprensione del software e delle specifiche di brevetti AI come EPO, USPTO e CNIPA.

• Service-oriented, pragmatico, rigoroso, pratico e collaborativo, con la capacità di impegnarsi con fiducia con partner R&D, team di categoria e stakeholder a diversi livelli di seniority.

• Fluente in inglese; francese è un plus.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

A Nestlé, ci preoccupiamo della nostra gente

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Eccitanti opportunità per sviluppare la tua carriera il tuo modo, attraverso diversi marchi, aziende, funzioni e regioni.

• Disposizioni di lavoro flessibili che facilitano la creatività e la collaborazione.

• Una cultura del rispetto, con diversità, equità e inclusione nel suo nucleo.

• Un ambiente dinamico internazionale che ti consente di imparare, sviluppare e crescere.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Patent Counsel in Digital & AI, your mission is to enable and protect Nestlé’s digital, AI-driven and electronics-centric innovations through pragmatic legal services and business-driven IP protection. You will act as the go-to Legal R&D partner for Digital & AI topics across the Nestlé R&D ecosystem, collaborating closely with R&D teams, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts. This is your opportunity to shape and grow the IP strategy for one of Nestlé’s most strategic innovation frontiers.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Digital & AI

• Develop and deliver the IP strategy for digital, AI and electronics-driven innovations, in close partnership with R&D teams, the patent team, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts.

• Lead business-driven patent filing and prosecution, Freedom-to-Operate assessments, oppositions of third-party patents and defense against third-party oppositions.

• Manage your patent portfolio with strong business alignment and rigorous cost management.

• Advise on IP matters in R&D collaborations, including Digital & AI partnerships, licensing and joint developments.

• Support Coffee & Systems and other categories on connected systems, digital platforms and AI-based innovations, in collaboration with category Patent Counsels.

• Partner with Nestlé Research, the Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional and other R&D centers to protect digital and AI innovations across categories.

• Promote passion for IP through awareness sessions, training and communication, while contributing to the awareness and enforcement of Nestlé patents in R&D and in the markets.

What will make you successful

• Fully qualified patent attorney, European Patent Attorney (EQE) and/or national qualification in a major jurisdiction such as the USA, with a background in Electronics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI or a related engineering discipline.

• Proven experience in digital, AI and/or electronics-related IP projects, ideally including software-implemented inventions, AI/ML, connected devices and computer-implemented business methods.

• More than 3 years of post-qualification experience with patent drafting, prosecution and Freedom-to-Operate assessments in the digital, electronics or AI space.

• Experience developing business-driven IP strategies across multiple jurisdictions, with a solid understanding of software and AI patenting specificities such as EPO, USPTO and CNIPA.

• Service-oriented, pragmatic, rigorous, hands-on and collaborative, with the ability to engage confidently with R&D partners, category teams and stakeholders at different levels of seniority.

• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way, across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

• Flexible working arrangements that facilitate creativity and collaboration.

• A culture of respect, with diversity, equity, and inclusion at its core.

• A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop, and grow.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, mit uns zu wachsen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und tragen Sie dazu bei, eine bessere und gesündere Welt zu gestalten, Menschen zu einem gesünderen Leben zu inspirieren und Auswirkungen in einem Umfang und Tempo zu erzielen, die einen Unterschied machen.

Être une force pour le bien et grandir à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin

En tant que conseiller en brevets dans le domaine du numérique et de l'intelligence artificielle, votre mission est de permettre et de protéger les innovations numériques, axées sur l'intelligence artificielle et l'électronique par des services juridiques pragmatiques et une protection de la propriété intellectuelle axée sur les entreprises. Vous jouerez le rôle de partenaire juridique en R-D pour les sujets liés au numérique et à l'IA dans l'écosystème de R-D de Nestlé, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes de R-D, les conseils en brevets, les conseils en R-D et les analystes en PI. C'est l'occasion de façonner et de développer la stratégie de propriété intellectuelle pour l'une des frontières les plus stratégiques de l'innovation de Nestlé.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que conseiller en brevets – Digital & AI

• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre la stratégie de PI pour les innovations numériques, de l'IA et de l'électronique, en partenariat étroit avec les équipes de R-D, l'équipe des brevets, les conseillers en R-D et les analystes de la PI.

• Diriger le dépôt et la poursuite de brevets dirigés par les entreprises, les évaluations de la liberté d'opérer, les oppositions de brevets de tiers et la défense contre les oppositions de tiers.

• Gérez votre portefeuille de brevets avec un fort alignement des activités et une gestion rigoureuse des coûts.

• Conseiller sur les questions de propriété intellectuelle dans les collaborations en R-D, y compris les partenariats numériques et d'IA, les licences et les développements conjoints.

• Soutenir Café & Systèmes et d'autres catégories sur les systèmes connectés, les plateformes numériques et les innovations basées sur l'IA, en collaboration avec la catégorie Conseils en brevets.

• Partenaire avec Nestlé Research, le Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional et d'autres centres de R-D pour protéger les innovations numériques et d'IA dans toutes les catégories.

• Promouvoir la passion pour la propriété intellectuelle au moyen de séances de sensibilisation, de formation et de communication, tout en contribuant à la sensibilisation et à l'application des brevets de Nestlé en R-D et sur les marchés.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Avocat en brevets entièrement qualifié, European Patent Attorney (EQE) et/ou qualification nationale dans une juridiction majeure comme les États-Unis, avec une formation en électronique, informatique, génie logiciel, science des données, AI ou une discipline d'ingénierie connexe.

• Expérience éprouvée dans les projets de propriété intellectuelle liés au numérique, à l'intelligence artificielle et/ou à l'électronique, y compris idéalement les inventions mises en œuvre par des logiciels, l'intelligence artificielle/ML, les appareils connectés et les méthodes commerciales mises en œuvre par ordinateur.

• Plus de 3 ans d'expérience post-qualification dans la rédaction des brevets, les poursuites et les évaluations Freedom-to-Operate dans l'espace numérique, électronique ou AI.

• Expérience de l'élaboration de stratégies de propriété intellectuelle axées sur l'entreprise dans plusieurs pays, avec une compréhension solide des caractéristiques des logiciels et des brevets d'IA telles que l'OEB, l'USPTO et l'INPA.

• Services orientés, pragmatiques, rigoureux, pratiques et collaboratifs, avec la capacité de s'engager avec des partenaires de R-D, des équipes de catégorie et des intervenants à différents niveaux d'ancienneté.

• Le français est un plus.

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu.

Chez Nestlé, nous nous soucions de notre peuple

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Des occasions passionnantes de développer votre carrière à votre manière, entre différentes marques, entreprises, fonctions et régions.

• Des modalités de travail flexibles qui facilitent la créativité et la collaboration.

• Une culture du respect, avec la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion au cœur.

• Un environnement international dynamique vous permettant d'apprendre, de se développer et de grandir.

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à grandir avec nous ?

Appliquez dès maintenant et aidez à façonner un monde meilleur et plus sain, inspirez les gens à vivre une vie plus saine et produisez un impact à une échelle et à un rythme qui fait la différence.

In qualità di Corporate Paralegal nel Corporate & Finance Counsel Team di Nestlé, la vostra missione è quella di supportare la gestione legale aziendale, la governance e la conformità alle entità giuridiche svizzere del Gruppo. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con altri team Legal & Compliance, Group Finance & Control, Human Resources, mercati in tutto il mondo, consulenti esterni e fornitori di servizi. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fare la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come un Corporate Paralegal

• Preparazione e esecuzione di documenti aziendali per riunioni di consiglio e azionisti, compresi gli ordini del giorno, i proxy e i verbali e le domande di supporto al Registro Commerciale.

• Contribuire alla preparazione dell’Assemblea generale annuale di Nestlé.

• Coordinamento legale, notarizzazione, apostille e processi di certificazione di proprietà con accuratezza.

• Mantenere registri azionari affidabili, dati di entità legale e record digitali per la segnalazione, due diligenza e conformità.

• Sostenere le operazioni aziendali, comprese le incorporazioni, le liquidazioni e le ristrutturazioni preparando documenti, monitorando progetti e coordinando i follow-up.

• Contribuire alla conformità di Nestlé agli obblighi di quotazione in corso derivanti dal regolamento sulle borse.

• Miglioramento continuo, digitalizzazione e standardizzazione dei processi legali, modelli e pratiche di gestione delle conoscenze.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare formazione legale o comprovata esperienza acquisita in Svizzera, con una forte conoscenza dell'ambiente legale e aziendale svizzero.

• Collaborare apertamente e in modo trasparente con i colleghi all'interno del team, partner commerciali interni e stakeholder esterni.

• Applicare forti competenze di project management per gestire le scadenze, coordinare gli stakeholder e seguire le questioni complesse.

• Utilizzando l'attenzione ai dettagli e un forte senso di proprietà per garantire la qualità dei dati, registri accurati e gestione riservata delle informazioni.

• Sfiorando i processi esistenti con una mentalità pragmatica e utilizzando strumenti digitali per migliorare i modi di lavorare.

• Comunicare fluentemente in francese e inglese; il tedesco è un bene forte.

• Dimostrare coraggio, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

A Nestlé, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e discussioni finali e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a essere una forza per il bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora le vite e il pianeta.

descriptionByLocale.de:

Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort / Vollzeit
Vertragsart/Dauer: Permanent

Startdatum: 1. Dezember 2026

Bewerbungsfrist: 15. September 2026

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und beschleunige Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern

Als Corporate Paralegal im Corporate & Finance Counsel Team von Nestlé ist es Ihre Mission, die unternehmensrechtliche Haushaltsführung, Governance und Compliance für die in der Schweiz ansässigen juristischen Personen der Gruppe zu unterstützen. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit anderen Legal & Compliance-Teams, Group Finance & Control, Human Resources, Märkten weltweit, externen Beratern und Dienstleistern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und einen großen Unterschied zu machen.

Wie Sie als Corporate Paralegal Einfluss nehmen werden

• Vorbereitung und Ausführung von Unternehmensdokumenten für Vorstands- und Aktionärsversammlungen, einschließlich Tagesordnungen, Proxies und Protokollen und Unterstützung von Anträgen auf das Handelsregister.

• Beitrag zur Vorbereitung der Hauptversammlung von Nestlé.

• Koordinieren Legalisierung, Beurkundung, Apostille und Eigentum Zertifizierungsprozesse mit Genauigkeit.

• Pflege zuverlässiger Aktienregister, Rechtsträgerdaten und digitaler Aufzeichnungen für die Berichterstattung, Due Diligence und Compliance.

• Unterstützung von Unternehmenstransaktionen, einschließlich Gründungen, Liquidationen und Restrukturierungen durch die Erstellung von Dokumenten, die Überwachung von Projekten und die Koordinierung von Folgemaßnahmen.

• Beitrag zur Einhaltung der laufenden Notierungspflichten von Nestlé, die sich aus der Börsenregulierung ergeben.

• Förderung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, Digitalisierung und Standardisierung von Rechtsprozessen, Vorlagen und Wissensmanagementpraktiken.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Mitbringen von juristischer Ausbildung oder nachgewiesener Erfahrung in der Schweiz, mit fundierten Kenntnissen des Schweizer Rechts- und Unternehmensumfelds.

• Offene und transparente Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen im Team, internen Geschäftspartnern und externen Stakeholdern.

• Anwendung starker Projektmanagementfähigkeiten, um Termine zu verwalten, Interessengruppen zu koordinieren und komplexe Angelegenheiten zu verfolgen.

• Mit Liebe zum Detail und einem starken Gefühl des Eigentums, um Datenqualität, genaue Aufzeichnungen und vertraulichen Umgang mit Informationen zu gewährleisten.

• Bestehende Prozesse mit einer pragmatischen Denkweise herausfordern und digitale Werkzeuge nutzen, um Arbeitsweisen zu verbessern.

• Fließend in Französisch und Englisch kommunizieren; Deutsch ist ein starkes Kapital.

• Demonstration von Mut, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

Bei Nestlé stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und abschließende Diskussionen und Angebote. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, eine Kraft für das Gute zu sein?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und beschleunigen Sie Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern.

En tant que parajuriste au sein de l'équipe Corporate & Finance Counsel chez Nestlé, votre mission est de soutenir l'entretien, la gouvernance et la conformité des personnes morales du Groupe. Vous ferez la différence en collaborant étroitement avec d'autres équipes juridiques et de conformité, Groupe Finance & Contrôle, Ressources humaines, marchés mondiaux, conseillers externes et prestataires de services. C'est l'occasion pour vous de prendre en main, de développer votre expertise et de faire une différence à l'échelle.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que parajuriste

• Préparation et exécution de documents d'entreprise pour les réunions du conseil d'administration et des actionnaires, y compris les ordres du jour, les procurations et les procès-verbaux et les demandes d'appui au Registre commercial.

• Contribution à la préparation de l'assemblée générale annuelle de Nestlé.

• Coordonner avec précision les processus de légalisation, de notariation, d'apostille et de certification de propriété.

• Tenir des registres de partage fiables, des données sur les personnes morales et des dossiers numériques pour la déclaration, la diligence raisonnable et la conformité.

• Soutenir les opérations d'entreprise, y compris les constitutions en société, les liquidations et les restructurations, en préparant des documents, en surveillant les projets et en coordonnant les suivis.

• Contribuer au respect par Nestlé des obligations d'inscription en cours découlant du règlement boursier.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue, la numérisation et la normalisation des processus juridiques, des modèles et des pratiques de gestion des connaissances.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une formation juridique ou une expérience éprouvée acquise en Suisse, avec une solide connaissance de l'environnement juridique et des entreprises suisses.

• Collaborer ouvertement et de manière transparente avec les collègues de l'équipe, les partenaires commerciaux internes et les intervenants externes.

• Appliquer de solides compétences en gestion de projet pour gérer les échéances, coordonner les intervenants et assurer le suivi des questions complexes.

• Utiliser l'attention aux détails et un fort sentiment de propriété pour assurer la qualité des données, l'exactitude des dossiers et le traitement confidentiel de l'information.

• Relever les processus existants avec un esprit pragmatique et utiliser des outils numériques pour améliorer les méthodes de travail.

• Communiquer couramment en français et en anglais; l'allemand est un atout important.

• Démontrer courage, rapidité et apprentissage continu.

Chez Nestlé, on place les gens au cœur de tout ce qu'on fait

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte cotisation de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche, ainsi que des discussions et des offres finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

jobs.title: Associate Specialist Lipids
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Full time
Contract type / duration: 2 years limited contract

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist Lipids at Nestlé Research, your mission is to strengthen scientific expertise and generate new insights in lipid physics and chemistry for food applications. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with multidisciplinary research teams, product development teams, expert networks, innovation partners, suppliers, universities, and research institutes. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist Lipids

• Building scientific knowledge of emerging methods, trends, and discoveries in lipid science and technology.

• Developing robust scientific concepts that translate lipid research into food applications and consumer benefits.

• Leading research projects and communicating scientific approaches and results to technical and business audiences.

• Designing and executing laboratory studies that advance understanding of lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Transferring scientific knowledge to development teams to accelerate innovation projects and successful product launches.

• Strengthening scientific visibility through intellectual property, publications, conference presentations, and coaching of students and technicians.

What will make you successful

• Holding a PhD in Food Science/Chemistry, Food Engineering, or a related area, with strong knowledge of lipid science, including lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Applying analytical thinking and problem-solving to turn science and technology into consumer and business value.

• Using project management, organisation, and communication skills to deliver clear scientific outcomes.

• Collaborating proactively across disciplines while showing initiative, integrity, and a passion for knowledge sharing.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione

Come Specialista Associato Lipids presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è di rafforzare le competenze scientifiche e generare nuove conoscenze nella fisica dei lipidi e nella chimica per le applicazioni alimentari. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con team di ricerca multidisciplinari, team di sviluppo di prodotti, reti di esperti, partner di innovazione, fornitori, università e istituti di ricerca. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Lipidi Specialista Associato

• Costruire la conoscenza scientifica dei metodi emergenti, delle tendenze e delle scoperte nella scienza e nella tecnologia dei lipidi.

• Sviluppare concetti scientifici robusti che traducono la ricerca lipidica in applicazioni alimentari e vantaggi per i consumatori.

• I principali progetti di ricerca e la comunicazione di approcci scientifici e risultati al pubblico tecnico e commerciale.

• Progettare ed eseguire studi di laboratorio che anticipano la comprensione della cristallizzazione dei lipidi, della strutturazione e dell'ossidazione.

• Trasferire conoscenze scientifiche ai team di sviluppo per accelerare i progetti di innovazione e lancio di prodotti di successo.

• Rafforzare la visibilità scientifica attraverso la proprietà intellettuale, pubblicazioni, presentazioni di conferenze e coaching di studenti e tecnici.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Tenendo un dottorato in Scienze alimentari / Chimica, Ingegneria alimentare, o una zona collegata, con una forte conoscenza della scienza dei lipidi, tra cui cristallizzazione dei lipidi, strutturazione e ossidazione.

• Applicare il pensiero analitico e risolvere i problemi per trasformare la scienza e la tecnologia in valore di consumo e di business.

• Utilizzo delle capacità di gestione del progetto, organizzazione e comunicazione per fornire risultati scientifici chiari.

• Collaborare attivamente attraverso le discipline, mostrando iniziativa, integrità e passione per la condivisione delle conoscenze.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva, orientata al benessere, per creare valore condiviso.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. A seconda del ruolo, può essere inclusa una valutazione video. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Gestaltung der Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen

Als Associate Specialist Lipids bei Nestlé Research besteht Ihre Mission darin, die wissenschaftliche Expertise zu stärken und neue Erkenntnisse in der Lipidphysik und -chemie für Lebensmittelanwendungen zu generieren. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit multidisziplinären Forschungsteams, Produktentwicklungsteams, Expertennetzwerken, Innovationspartnern, Lieferanten, Universitäten und Forschungsinstituten zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Associate Specialist Lipids eine Wirkung erzielen

• Aufbau wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse über neue Methoden, Trends und Entdeckungen in der Lipidwissenschaft und -technologie.

• Entwicklung robuster wissenschaftlicher Konzepte, die die Lipidforschung in Lebensmittelanwendungen und Verbrauchervorteile umsetzen.

• Leitung von Forschungsprojekten und Vermittlung wissenschaftlicher Ansätze und Ergebnisse an technische und wirtschaftliche Zielgruppen.

• Entwerfen und Durchführen von Laborstudien, die das Verständnis von Lipidkristallisation, Strukturierung und Oxidation verbessern.

• Transfer wissenschaftlichen Wissens an Entwicklungsteams, um Innovationsprojekte und erfolgreiche Produkteinführungen zu beschleunigen.

• Stärkung der wissenschaftlichen Sichtbarkeit durch geistiges Eigentum, Publikationen, Konferenzpräsentationen und Coaching von Studenten und Technikern.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Einen PhD in Food Science / Chemie, Food Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Lipidwissenschaft, einschließlich Lipidkristallisation, Strukturierung und Oxidation.

• Anwendung analytischen Denkens und Problemlösung, um Wissenschaft und Technologie in Verbraucher- und Geschäftswert zu verwandeln.

• Mit Projektmanagement, Organisation und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten klare wissenschaftliche Ergebnisse zu liefern.

• Proaktive Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen hinweg und gleichzeitig Initiative, Integrität und Leidenschaft für den Wissensaustausch.

• Fließend Englisch kommunizieren; zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise, um gemeinsame Werte zu schaffen.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Façonner l'avenir grâce aux percées scientifiques et à l'innovation

En tant que spécialiste associé des lipides chez Nestlé Research, votre mission est de renforcer l'expertise scientifique et de générer de nouvelles connaissances en physique des lipides et en chimie pour les applications alimentaires. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec des équipes de recherche multidisciplinaires, des équipes de développement de produits, des réseaux d'experts, des partenaires d'innovation, des fournisseurs, des universités et des instituts de recherche. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux et la planète.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste associé Lipids

• Développer les connaissances scientifiques sur les méthodes, les tendances et les découvertes émergentes en science et technologie des lipides.

• Élaborer des concepts scientifiques solides qui traduisent la recherche sur les lipides en applications alimentaires et en avantages pour les consommateurs.

• Diriger les projets de recherche et communiquer les approches et les résultats scientifiques aux publics techniques et commerciaux.

• Concevoir et exécuter des études de laboratoire qui permettent de mieux comprendre la cristallisation, la structuration et l'oxydation des lipides.

• Transférer les connaissances scientifiques aux équipes de développement pour accélérer les projets d'innovation et les lancements réussis de produits.

• Renforcer la visibilité scientifique par la propriété intellectuelle, les publications, les présentations de conférences et l'encadrement des étudiants et des techniciens.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Titulaire d'un doctorat en sciences alimentaires/chimie, génie alimentaire, ou un domaine connexe, avec une solide connaissance de la science des lipides, y compris la cristallisation des lipides, la structuration et l'oxydation.

• Appliquer la réflexion analytique et la résolution de problèmes pour transformer la science et la technologie en valeur pour les consommateurs et les entreprises.

• Utiliser les compétences en gestion de projet, organisation et communication pour obtenir des résultats scientifiques clairs.

• Collaborer de façon proactive entre les disciplines tout en faisant preuve d'initiative, d'intégrité et d'une passion pour le partage des connaissances.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais; d'autres langues sont un avantage.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être, pour créer une valeur partagée.

Chez Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales
