jobs.title: Senior Technician
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide high-quality analytical support that helps research and operations teams make confident, science-based decisions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, analytical experts, technical teams and partners across Nestlé Research. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics

• Delivering reliable analytical data that supports research, product quality and operational decisions.

• Developing and applying sample preparation methods within projects, including approaches for allergens, microparticles, micronutrients and phytochemicals analysis as well as spectroscopic measurements.

• Operating and maintaining advanced analytical equipment to ensure robust, timely and high-quality results.

• Evaluating analytical outcomes critically and turning results into clear insights for project teams and stakeholders.

• Contributing to method development and providing technical assistance to markets, including analytical support for allergen-related topics where the role may require handling or being in direct contact with allergenic food materials.

• Supporting project teams with technical assistance, sample preparation for trace analysis and analytical interpretation to ensure robust delivery of project objectives.

• Sharing expertise with colleagues, apprentices and students to build capability across analytical activities.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a Bachelor’s degree, CFC or equivalent qualification in analytical chemistry or a related field, with solid experience in sample preparation gained in industry or academia.

• Applying hands-on knowledge of allergen analysis and being comfortable working in a laboratory environment where allergenic food materials may be handled, prepared or analyzed, with potential direct contact as part of the role. You will also bring knowledge of spectroscopic measurements such as infrared, Raman or X-ray fluorescence, ideally including microparticle analysis. Knowledge in trace analysis and liquid chromatography is a plus.

• Using good laboratory practices, quality and safety standards to deliver accurate, compliant and trusted results.

• Collaborating with curiosity, analytical rigor and a solution-oriented mindset in diverse technical teams.

• Communicating confidently in English and French.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Losanna, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: In loco / A tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Senior Technician in Micronutrients e Phytochemicals Analytics presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di fornire un supporto analitico di alta qualità che aiuta i team di ricerca e di operazioni a prendere decisioni sicure e basate sulla scienza. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, esperti analitici, team tecnici e partner in Nestlé Research. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Senior Technician in Micronutrienti e Phytochemicals Analytics

• Fornire dati analitici affidabili che supportano la ricerca, la qualità del prodotto e le decisioni operative.

• Sviluppare e applicare metodi di preparazione dei campioni all'interno dei progetti, compresi gli approcci per allergeni, microparticelle, micronutrienti e analisi dei fitochimici e le misurazioni spettroscopiche.

• Funzionamento e mantenimento di attrezzature analitiche avanzate per garantire risultati robusti, tempestivi e di alta qualità.

• Valutare i risultati analitici in modo critico e trasformare i risultati in chiare intuizioni per i team di progetto e gli stakeholder.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo dei metodi e fornire assistenza tecnica ai mercati, compreso il supporto analitico per gli argomenti legati all'allergene in cui il ruolo può richiedere la manipolazione o essere in contatto diretto con materiali alimentari allergeni.

• Sostenere i team di progetto con assistenza tecnica, preparazione del campione per l'analisi delle tracce e l'interpretazione analitica per garantire una fornitura robusta degli obiettivi del progetto.

• Condivisione delle competenze con colleghi, apprendisti e studenti per costruire capacità nelle attività analitiche.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una laurea, CFC o qualifica equivalente in chimica analitica o un campo correlato, con solida esperienza nella preparazione del campione acquisita nell'industria o nell'accademia.

• Applicare la conoscenza pratica dell'analisi degli allergeni e lavorare comodo in un ambiente di laboratorio in cui i materiali alimentari allergeni possono essere trattati, preparati o analizzati, con potenziale contatto diretto come parte del ruolo. Potrai anche portare la conoscenza di misure spettroscopiche come la fluorescenza a raggi infrarossi, Raman o raggi X, idealmente compreso l'analisi microparticella. La conoscenza nell'analisi delle tracce e la cromatografia liquida è un plus.

• Utilizzando buone pratiche di laboratorio, standard di qualità e sicurezza per fornire risultati accurati, conformi e affidabili.

• Collaborare con curiosità, rigore analitico e una mentalità orientata alla soluzione in diversi team tecnici.

• Comunicare con fiducia in inglese e francese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva, orientata al benessere, per creare valore condiviso.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. A seconda del ruolo, può essere inclusa una valutazione video. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Wie Sie als Senior-Techniker in Mikronährstoffen und Phytochemikalien Analytics etwas bewirken können

• Bereitstellung zuverlässiger Analysedaten, die Forschung, Produktqualität und operative Entscheidungen unterstützen.

• Entwicklung und Anwendung von Probenvorbereitungsmethoden im Rahmen von Projekten, einschließlich Ansätzen für Allergene, Mikropartikel, Mikronährstoffe und Phytochemikalienanalysen sowie spektroskopische Messungen.

• Betrieb und Wartung fortschrittlicher Analysegeräte, um robuste, zeitnahe und qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.

• Die Analyseergebnisse kritisch bewerten und die Ergebnisse in klare Erkenntnisse für Projektteams und Interessengruppen umwandeln.

• Beitrag zur Methodenentwicklung und technische Unterstützung der Märkte, einschließlich analytischer Unterstützung bei allergenbezogenen Themen, bei denen die Rolle möglicherweise den Umgang mit allergenen Lebensmitteln erfordert oder in direktem Kontakt mit diesen steht.

• Unterstützung der Projektteams durch technische Unterstützung, Probenvorbereitung für die Spurenanalyse und analytische Interpretation, um eine robuste Umsetzung der Projektziele zu gewährleisten.

• Austausch von Fachwissen mit Kollegen, Auszubildenden und Studenten, um Fähigkeiten über analytische Aktivitäten hinweg aufzubauen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie einen Bachelor-Abschluss, CFC oder gleichwertige Qualifikation in der analytischen Chemie oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit solider Erfahrung in der Probenvorbereitung in der Industrie oder der Wissenschaft gewonnen.

• Anwendung von praktischen Kenntnissen der Allergenanalyse und komfortables Arbeiten in einer Laborumgebung, in der allergene Lebensmittelmaterialien behandelt, zubereitet oder analysiert werden können, mit potenziellem direktem Kontakt als Teil der Rolle. Sie werden auch Kenntnisse über spektroskopische Messungen wie Infrarot-, Raman- oder Röntgenfluoreszenz mitbringen, idealerweise einschließlich Mikropartikelanalyse. Kenntnisse in der Spurenanalyse und Flüssigkeitschromatographie sind ein Plus.

• Verwendung guter Laborpraktiken, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards, um genaue, konforme und vertrauenswürdige Ergebnisse zu liefern.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Neugier, analytischer Strenge und einer lösungsorientierten Denkweise in verschiedenen technischen Teams.

• Selbstsicher in Englisch und Französisch kommunizieren.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise, um gemeinsame Werte zu schaffen.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Abhängig von der Rolle kann eine Videobewertung enthalten sein. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: Lausanne, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Sur place / À temps plein
Type / durée du contrat: Permanent

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que technicien principal en micronutriments et en Phytochimie Analytics chez Nestlé Research, votre mission est de fournir un soutien analytique de haute qualité qui aide les équipes de recherche et d'exploitation à prendre des décisions fiables et fondées sur la science. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec des scientifiques, des experts en analyse, des équipes techniques et des partenaires de Nestlé Research. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux et la planète.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que technicien principal en micronutriments et Phytochimiques Analytics

• Fournir des données analytiques fiables qui appuient la recherche, la qualité des produits et les décisions opérationnelles.

• Élaborer et appliquer des méthodes de préparation d'échantillons dans le cadre de projets, y compris des approches pour les allergènes, les microparticules, les micronutriments et les analyses phytochimiques, ainsi que des mesures spectroscopiques.

• Exploitation et entretien d'équipement analytique avancé pour assurer des résultats robustes, opportuns et de haute qualité.

• Évaluer les résultats d'analyse de façon critique et transformer les résultats en idées claires pour les équipes de projet et les intervenants.

• Contribuer à l'élaboration de méthodes et fournir une assistance technique aux marchés, y compris un soutien analytique pour les sujets liés aux allergènes, lorsque le rôle peut nécessiter la manipulation ou être en contact direct avec des matériaux alimentaires allergènes.

• Aider les équipes de projet à fournir une assistance technique, à préparer des échantillons pour l'analyse des traces et l'interprétation analytique afin d'assurer la réalisation des objectifs du projet.

• Partager l'expertise avec les collègues, les apprentis et les étudiants pour renforcer les capacités dans toutes les activités analytiques.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter un baccalauréat, un CFC ou une qualification équivalente en chimie analytique ou dans un domaine connexe, avec une solide expérience dans la préparation d'échantillons acquise dans l'industrie ou le milieu universitaire.

• Appliquer la connaissance pratique de l'analyse des allergènes et être à l'aise de travailler dans un milieu de laboratoire où les matériaux alimentaires allergènes peuvent être manipulés, préparés ou analysés, avec un contact direct potentiel dans le cadre du rôle. Vous apporterez également une connaissance des mesures spectroscopiques telles que l'infrarouge, Raman ou la fluorescence par rayons X, y compris idéalement l'analyse des microparticules. La connaissance de l'analyse des traces et de la chromatographie liquide est un atout.

• Utiliser de bonnes pratiques de laboratoire, des normes de qualité et de sécurité pour obtenir des résultats précis, conformes et fiables.

• Collaborer avec curiosité, rigueur analytique et un état d'esprit orienté vers la solution dans diverses équipes techniques.

• Communiquer avec confiance en anglais et en français.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être, pour créer une valeur partagée.

Chez Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte cotisation de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Selon le rôle, une évaluation vidéo peut être incluse. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

jobs.title: Technician in Lipids Analytics
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Technician in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics department at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide analytical support in lipids analytics and deliver timely, high-quality data that supports research, innovation, and operational needs. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, experts, peers across analytical groups, and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Technician in Lipids Analytics

• Delivering timely, high-quality lipid data that advances research projects and supports operational priorities.

• Executing lipid extraction and chromatography experiments with accuracy, and rigor.

• Implementing analytical methods and technical solutions that improve lipid analysis capabilities.

• Advancing innovation by exploring and applying new analytical technologies that expand what is possible in lipids analytics.

What will make you successful

• Bringing knowledge in lipid classes, lipid extraction, and the analysis of lipophilic compounds with a similar position in industry or in academia.

• Applying knowledge of gas chromatography and liquid chromatography methods to deliver precise analytical results.

• Collaborating with a quality-focused, proactive and curiosity mindset while working confidently across diverse teams and stakeholders.

• Communicating fluently in French and English is a plus.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially. All internal candidates whose skills most closely align with the role’s requirements will be considered. Please discuss your application with your HR Business Partner and line manager before applying.

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Technician in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics di Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di fornire supporto analitico nell'analisi dei lipidi e fornire dati tempestivi e di alta qualità che supportano la ricerca, l'innovazione e le esigenze operative. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, esperti, coetanei tra gruppi analitici e partner esterni. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come tecnico in Lipids Analytics

• Fornire dati lipidi tempestivi e di alta qualità che promuovano progetti di ricerca e supportano le priorità operative.

• Eseguire esperimenti di estrazione lipidica e cromatografia con precisione e rigore.

• Implementare metodi analitici e soluzioni tecniche che migliorano le capacità di analisi dei lipidi.

• Migliorare l'innovazione esplorando e applicando nuove tecnologie analitiche che espandono ciò che è possibile nell'analisi dei lipidi.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare conoscenza nelle classi lipidi, estrazione dei lipidi, e l'analisi dei composti lipofilici con una posizione simile nell'industria o nell'accademia.

• Applicando la conoscenza della cromatografia del gas e dei metodi di cromatografia liquida per fornire risultati analitici precisi.

• Collaborando con una mentalità focalizzata sulla qualità, proattiva e curiosità, lavorando con fiducia in team e stakeholder diversi.

• Comunicare fluentemente in francese e inglese è un plus.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que technicien en lipides et en analyse métabolique à Nestlé Research, votre mission est de fournir un soutien analytique en analyse des lipides et de fournir des données de haute qualité qui soutiennent la recherche, l'innovation et les besoins opérationnels. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec des scientifiques, des experts, des pairs de groupes analytiques et des partenaires externes. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux et la planète.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que technicien en analyse des lipides

• Fournir en temps opportun des données sur les lipides de haute qualité qui font avancer les projets de recherche et appuient les priorités opérationnelles.

• Exécuter des expériences d'extraction lipidique et de chromatographie avec précision et rigueur.

• Mettre en oeuvre des méthodes analytiques et des solutions techniques qui améliorent les capacités d'analyse des lipides.

• Promouvoir l'innovation en explorant et en appliquant de nouvelles technologies analytiques qui élargissent ce qui est possible dans l'analyse des lipides.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter des connaissances sur les classes de lipides, l'extraction des lipides et l'analyse de composés lipophiles ayant une position similaire dans l'industrie ou dans les universités.

• Appliquer les connaissances des méthodes de chromatographie en phase gazeuse et de chromatographie en phase liquide pour obtenir des résultats analytiques précis.

• Collaborer avec un esprit de qualité, proactif et curieux tout en travaillant avec confiance entre diverses équipes et parties prenantes.

• Communiquer couramment en français et en anglais est un plus.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être.

À Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

jobs.title: Junior Corporate Pensions Actuary
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Deadline for applications : 13 November 2026

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Junior Corporate Pension Actuary at Nestlé, your mission is to support the evolution of pension plan design, strengthen actuarial governance and ensure reliable pension reporting across our global operations. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with corporate actuaries, Human Resources teams, local markets, pension funds and external advisers in a company with significant post-employment footprint with more than 350 pension plans in 80 different countries. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Junior Corporate Pension Actuary

• Monitoring key pension metrics, projecting and reporting on a monthly basis.

• Contributing to IAS19 calculations for Group reporting and actuarial studies (plan changes, ALM study, funding valuations).

• Supporting the development of standards and guidelines for post-employment benefits and their implementation.

• Collaborating with Human Resources, Markets, and Pension funds in the design and management of their pensions.

• Supporting the selection and monitoring of local actuarial consultants, benefit administrators and insurers for risk transfers.

• Participating in de-risking projects.

What will make you successful

• Master’s degree in actuarial science and practical knowledge of international pension consulting, pension accounting and post-employment benefits.

• A first experience in actuarial valuations, funding, accounting and financial reporting. Asset management and benefit administration exposure is a plus.

• Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and adapt messages to different stakeholders.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Vevey, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Termine ultimo per le domande: 13 novembre 2026

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta

In qualità di Junior Corporate Pension Actuary presso Nestlé, la vostra missione è di sostenere l'evoluzione della progettazione del piano pensionistico, rafforzare la governance attuariale e garantire un reporting pensionistico affidabile attraverso le nostre operazioni globali. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con gli azionari aziendali, i team di Risorse Umane, i mercati locali, i fondi pensione e i consulenti esterni in una società con significativa impronta post-occupazione con oltre 350 piani pensionistici in 80 paesi diversi. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fornire risultati significativi che fanno la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come Junior Corporate Pension Actuary

• Monitoraggio delle metriche principali della pensione, progettazione e reporting su base mensile.

• Contribuire ai calcoli IAS19 per gli studi di reportistica e attuariale del Gruppo (cambiamenti dei piani, studio ALM, valutazioni di finanziamento).

• Sostenere lo sviluppo di norme e linee guida per le prestazioni post-occupazione e la loro attuazione.

• Collaborare con risorse umane, mercati e fondi pensione nella progettazione e gestione delle loro pensioni.

• Sostenere la selezione e il monitoraggio di consulenti attuariali locali, amministratori di beneficio e assicuratori per i trasferimenti di rischio.

• Partecipazione a progetti di de-risking.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Laurea magistrale in scienze attuariali e conoscenza pratica della consulenza pensionistica internazionale, della contabilità pensionistica e delle prestazioni post-occupazione.

• Una prima esperienza di valutazione attuariale, finanziamento, contabilità e rendicontazione finanziaria. La gestione delle risorse e l'esposizione all'amministrazione dei benefici è un vantaggio.

• Buona comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente e adattare messaggi a diversi stakeholder.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

• Dimostrando coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso.

A Nestlé, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. What will make you successful

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

• Using data analysis, documentation and reporting tools to create clear, traceable and actionable technical outputs.

• Collaborating across scientific, technical and operational audiences with practical problem solving, attention to detail and timely communication.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Collaborer avec agilité entre les équipes, les marchés et les environnements matriciels tout en communiquant clairement.

• Fluente in inglese, scritto e parlato

• Erkundung globaler Esskulturen, Kochtechniken und Essgewohnheiten der Verbraucher, um ein tieferes Verständnis der Küchen und kulinarischen Trends zu schaffen.

• Derzeit verfolgen einen Abschluss in Kulinarischen Künsten, mit anfänglicher praktischer Küchenerfahrung und einer Leidenschaft für Essen, Rezeptkonzeptionierung, kulinarisches Storytelling und die Schaffung unvergesslicher Essenserlebnisse durch wirkungsvolle Präsentationen, Plattieren, Verkostungserlebnisse und Prototypenerstellung.

Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As Machine Quality Senior Specialist at Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages , your mission is to build trust and deliver outstanding consumer experiences by embedding food safety, compliance and quality into beverage systems of both Nespresso and Nestlé Dolce Gusto from the earliest design stages. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with project managers, category teams, factories, regulatory and legal partners, consumer services and suppliers. This is your opportunity to drive cutting-edge innovation, strengthen your expertise and deliver meaningful results to create unique consumer experiences at global scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Machine Quality Senior Specialist

• Safeguarding food safety, regulatory compliance and consumer expectations throughout beverage-system development.

• Embedding quality by design across new products, packaging, machines and production lines to improve right-first-time delivery.

• Driving robust validation plans, quality requirements and process capability from ideation through technical approval and launch.

• Anticipating quality risks through root-cause analysis, risk assessment and failure mode analysis, enabling pragmatic decisions.

• Resolving quality issues with factories and consumer service teams and ensuring corrective actions strengthen future developments.

• Building quality capability by coaching colleagues, sharing knowledge across sites and turning project lessons into continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of quality systems, food safety, good manufacturing practices, product development and manufacturing.

• Applying root-cause analysis, risk analysis and failure mode analysis to complex design and production challenges.

• Using project management skills to align priorities, manage several developments and deliver practical solutions.

• Collaborating assertively and transparently, influencing decisions while balancing quality requirements with business realities.

• Demonstrating agility and adaptability while navigating complexity, shifting priorities and evolving project needs.

• Communicating fluently and effectively in English across all levels of the organization; proficiency in additional languages is an advantage.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre

Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con project manager, team di categoria, fabbriche, partner normativi e legali, servizi di consumo e fornitori. Questa è la vostra occasione per guidare l'innovazione all'avanguardia, rafforzare la vostra esperienza e fornire risultati significativi per creare esperienze di consumo uniche a livello globale.

Come farete un impatto come specialista di qualità della macchina

• Salvaguardare la sicurezza alimentare, la conformità normativa e le aspettative dei consumatori in tutto lo sviluppo del sistema delle bevande.

• Integrare la qualità attraverso la progettazione di nuovi prodotti, imballaggi, macchine e linee di produzione per migliorare la consegna in tempo reale.

• Guidare piani di validazione robusti, requisiti di qualità e capacità di processo dall'ideazione attraverso approvazione tecnica e lancio.

• Anticipazione dei rischi di qualità attraverso analisi, valutazione del rischio e analisi della modalità di fallimento, consentendo decisioni pragmatiche.

• Risolvere i problemi di qualità con le fabbriche e i team di servizi di consumo e garantire azioni correttive rafforzare gli sviluppi futuri.

• Capacità di costruzione di qualità allenando i colleghi, condividere le conoscenze sui siti e trasformare le lezioni di progetto in miglioramento continuo.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte conoscenza di sistemi di qualità, sicurezza alimentare, buone pratiche di produzione, sviluppo del prodotto e produzione.

• Applicando analisi, analisi dei rischi e analisi delle modalità di guasto a complesse sfide di progettazione e produzione.

• Utilizzando le competenze di project management per allineare le priorità, gestire diversi sviluppi e fornire soluzioni pratiche.

• Collaborando in modo assertivo e trasparente, influenzando le decisioni, bilanciando i requisiti di qualità con le realtà aziendali.

Als Spezialist für Biostatistik bei Nestlé Research besteht Ihre Mission darin, statistisches Fachwissen für klinische Studien bereitzustellen, von Studiendesign und Analyseplanung bis hin zu Programmierung, Berichterstattung und wissenschaftlicher Kommunikation. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Spezialist für Biostatistik etwas bewirken können

• Bereitstellung von statistischem Fachwissen, das das Design klinischer Studien stärkt, wissenschaftliche Ziele an robusten statistischen Hypothesen ausrichtet und die Evidenzerzeugung für Ernährung, medizinische Ernährung und pharmazeutische Vermögenswerte unterstützt.

• Entwicklung hochwertiger klinischer Protokolle und statistischer Analysepläne zur Unterstützung einer klaren Studiendurchführung.

• Programmierung statistischer Analysen in R oder SAS, um genaue, reproduzierbare und gut organisierte Ergebnisse zu liefern, die eine sichere Entscheidungsfindung ermöglichen.

• Präsentieren der Ergebnisse klinischer Studien in einer klaren und aussagekräftigen Weise, die Teams helfen, die Ergebnisse zu interpretieren und Daten in wissenschaftliche Beweise zu übersetzen.

• Förderung der Qualität, des Risikomanagements und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von klinischen Studienstatistiken und Datenanalysepraktiken.

• Austausch von Wissen und Mentoring-Kollegen, um Fähigkeiten, Konsistenz und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz im gesamten Biostatistik-Team aufzubauen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Einbringen starker Biostatistik und klinischer Studienkompetenz, um die Generierung hochwertiger wissenschaftlicher Beweise für Ernährung, medizinische Ernährung und pharmazeutische Vermögenswerte zu unterstützen.

• Anwendung analytischen Denkens, Organisation und Projektmanagement Fähigkeiten, um zuverlässige Ergebnisse in einem komplexen Forschungsumfeld zu liefern.

• Verwendung statistischer Programmierung sowie klinischer Forschungsstandards wie ICH GCP, EMA, FDA und CDISC-Richtlinien zur Unterstützung einer konformen und effektiven Studienabwicklung.

• Zusammenarbeit mit wissenschaftlichen und Geschäftspartnern durch klare Kommunikation, Neugier und eine qualitätsorientierte Denkweise.

• fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise, um gemeinsame Werte zu schaffen.

En tant que biostatisticienne spécialiste à Nestlé Research, votre mission est de fournir une expertise statistique à travers les essais cliniques, de la conception d'études et la planification d'analyses à la programmation, l'établissement de rapports et la communication scientifique. descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc and EPFL sites, Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: On-site, with flexibility to work across both locations
Contract type / duration: Internship, 6 months
Activity rate: 100%
Target start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As a Cell Biology and Nutrient Absorption Intern at Nestlé Research, your mission is to explore how dietary lipids are absorbed using an advanced human intestinal cell model and to generate insights that strengthen nutrition and health research. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, laboratory technicians, research assistants and multidisciplinary partners across Nestlé Research and local research facilities. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a Cell Biology and Nutrient Absorption Intern

• Investigating how dietary lipids are absorbed using a human stem cell-derived intestinal model

• Generating high-quality experimental data and mechanistic insights on lipid uptake, metabolism and bioavailability

• Optimizing lipid preparation, cell-based experiments and accurate analytical quantification

• Connecting experimental findings with scientific literature in intestinal biology, lipid metabolism and nutrition

• Communicating results through clear analyses, reports, presentations and discussions with multidisciplinary partner

What will make you successful

• Being a student or fresh graduate in Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, Nutrition, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• Bringing a strong interest in gut physiology, lipid metabolism and advanced laboratory models that recreate biological processes

• Having practical familiarity with molecular and cellular biology techniques, alongside data analysis and basic statistical tools

• Being able to review and interpret scientific publications, while working with curiosity, precision, initiative and a collaborative mindset

• Communicating fluently in English

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Seien Sie eine Kraft für das Gute und verwandeln Sie Ihr Potenzial in etwas Außergewöhnliches

Als Intern für Zellbiologie und Nährstoffabsorption bei Nestlé Research besteht Ihre Mission darin, zu untersuchen, wie Nahrungsfette mit einem fortschrittlichen menschlichen Darmzellmodell absorbiert werden, und Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die die Ernährungs- und Gesundheitsforschung stärken. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Wissenschaftlern, Labortechnikern, Forschungsassistenten und multidisziplinären Partnern in Nestlé Research und lokalen Forschungseinrichtungen zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, etwas zu bewirken und gleichzeitig Erfahrung und Mentorenschaft zu sammeln, um Ihre Karriere anzukurbeln.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss als Zellbiologie und Nährstoffabsorption Intern machen

• Untersuchung, wie diätetische Lipide mit einem menschlichen Stammzellen-abgeleiteten Darmmodell absorbiert werden

• Generierung hochwertiger experimenteller Daten und mechanistischer Erkenntnisse zu Lipidaufnahme, Metabolismus und Bioverfügbarkeit

• Optimierung der Lipidpräparation, zellbasierte Experimente und genaue analytische Quantifizierung

• Verbindung von experimentellen Erkenntnissen mit wissenschaftlicher Literatur in Darmbiologie, Lipidstoffwechsel und Ernährung

• Ergebnisse durch klare Analysen, Berichte, Präsentationen und Diskussionen mit multidisziplinären Partnern kommunizieren

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Als Student oder frischer Absolvent in Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biomedizinische Wissenschaften, Ernährung, Life Sciences oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Ein starkes Interesse an Darmphysiologie, Lipidstoffwechsel und fortschrittlichen Labormodellen, die biologische Prozesse nachbilden

• Praktische Vertrautheit mit molekular- und zellbiologischen Techniken neben Datenanalyse und grundlegenden statistischen Werkzeugen

• In der Lage sein, wissenschaftliche Publikationen zu überprüfen und zu interpretieren, während Sie mit Neugier, Präzision, Initiative und einer kollaborativen Denkweise arbeiten

• fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für bürobasierte Rollen)

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Karriere mit uns zu beginnen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und verwandeln Sie Ihr Potenzial in etwas Außergewöhnliches.

Type de contrat / durée: Stage, 6 mois
Taux d'activité: 100%
Date cible : Dès que possible

Soyez une force pour le bien et transformez votre potentiel en quelque chose d'extraordinaire

En tant que stagiaire en biologie cellulaire et en absorption des nutriments à Nestlé Research, votre mission est d'explorer comment les lipides alimentaires sont absorbés à l'aide d'un modèle avancé de cellules intestinales humaines et de générer des idées qui renforcent la recherche en nutrition et en santé. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les scientifiques, les techniciens de laboratoire, les assistants de recherche et les partenaires multidisciplinaires de Nestlé Research et des établissements de recherche locaux. C'est l'occasion pour vous de faire un impact tout en prenant la main sur l'expérience et le mentorat pour démarrer votre carrière.

Comment vous allez faire un impact comme un interne de biologie cellulaire et d'absorption des nutriments

• Étudier comment les lipides alimentaires sont absorbés à l'aide d'un modèle intestinal dérivé des cellules souches humaines

• Générer des données expérimentales de haute qualité et des idées mécanistes sur l'absorption, le métabolisme et la biodisponibilité des lipides

• Optimisation de la préparation lipidique, expériences cellulaires et quantification analytique précise

• Relier les résultats expérimentaux à la littérature scientifique en biologie intestinale, métabolisme des lipides et nutrition

• Communiquer les résultats au moyen d'analyses claires, de rapports, de présentations et de discussions avec des partenaires multidisciplinaires

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Être étudiant ou diplômé en biologie, biotechnologie, sciences biomédicales, nutrition, sciences de la vie ou un domaine connexe.

• Apporter un vif intérêt à la physiologie intestinale, au métabolisme lipidique et aux modèles de laboratoire avancés qui recréent les processus biologiques

• Connaissance pratique des techniques de biologie moléculaire et cellulaire, ainsi que de l'analyse des données et des outils statistiques de base

• Être capable d'examiner et d'interpréter des publications scientifiques, tout en travaillant avec curiosité, précision, initiative et esprit de collaboration

• Communiquer couramment en anglais

• Démontrer le courage, la collaboration, la rapidité et l'apprentissage continu, tout en traduisant les idées en un impact mesurable et en créant une valeur partagée.

À Nestlé Research, nous mettons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Contribution aux soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sécuritaire pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents est établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à commencer votre carrière avec nous ?

Appliquer maintenant et transformer votre potentiel en quelque chose d'extraordinaire.

En tant qu' Automaticien(ne) & Spécialiste Digital , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le bon fonctionnement de nos installations de production et dans la digitalisation de l’usine. Véritable référent technique, vous assurerez la fiabilité des systèmes d’automation, participerez aux dépannages et contribuerez au développement des outils digitaux qui soutiennent nos opérations au quotidien.

Übersicht Position

Standort: Konolfingen, Schweiz
Unternehmen: Nestlé Schweiz S.A.
Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%
Vertragsart: Unbefristet
Anstellungsbeginn: 1. Juni 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung

Benefits

41 Stunden pro Woche, je nach Schichtplan
Min. 25 Tage Ferien (je nach Alter mehr)
Kostenfreier Parkplatz
Kostenfreies Schichtessen
Schichtzulagen, die die gesetzlichen Vorgaben überschreiten
13. Monatslohn
Rabatt im Nestlé Shop (vor Ort in Konolfingen)
Viele Möglichkeiten zur Karriereentwicklung und persönlichen Entfaltung

Kurzüberblick Position

550 Mitarbeitende, die für die Herstellung hochwertiger Säuglingsnahrung für das In- und Ausland zuständig sind, prägen das dynamische, hochautomatisierte Arbeitsumfeld der Fabrik Konolfingen. Dies stellt täglich hohe Ansprüche an unser Team in Bezug auf Einhaltung von Hygienebestimmungen und Arbeitssicherheit. Möchten auch Sie Teil unseres Teams sein?

Zur Verstärkung unseres Abteilung Produktion suchen wir eine kommunikative und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit als Anlagenführer:in .

Ein Tag im Leben eines/-r Anlagenführer:in

• Aufbereitung von Milch mit Hilfe moderner Produktionsanlagen

• Durchführung der Rohstoffaufgabe, Sprühtrocknung sowie Mischung, Bereitstellung und Abfüllung von Pulver

• Durchführung des Reinigungsprozesses (CIP-Reinigungen) sowie allgemeine Reinigungsarbeiten gemäss den bestehenden Qualitätsvorgaben

• Dokumentation der Produktions- und Reinigungsabläufe

• Tätigkeiten im Linienlabor

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 4-Schicht-Betrieb

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

jobs.title: R&D Intern - Clinical Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-Chez-Les-Blanc, Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Activity rate: 100%
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Start date: February 2027 or August 2027, flexible

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an R&D Intern in Clinical Digital Transformation at Nestlé Research, your mission is to help accelerate the use of digital health technologies, data and automation in clinical research. You will collaborate closely with scientists, clinical research professionals, data specialists and operational teams to assess digital solutions, analyze and visualize digital or clinical data, and optimize clinical research processes. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as an R&D Intern in Clinical Digital Transformation

•
Assessing digital health technologies, including wearables and sensors, to determine their scientific validity, measurement performance, usability and suitability for clinical studies.

•
Reviewing scientific and technical literature related to digital measures, validation, usability and operational testing of digital devices.

•
Analyzing clinical and digital datasets to identify patterns, assess data quality and translate findings into clear visualizations, dashboards and actionable insights.

•
Identifying opportunities to automate repetitive activities and improve data-processing workflows across clinical research processes.

•
Supporting digital technology deployment in clinical studies, from protocols and questionnaires to testing, reporting and recommendations for scientific and operational teams.

What will make you successful

•
Being a current student or fresh graduate in life sciences engineering or a related field.

•
Bringing a strong interest in applying digital technologies and data science to clinical research and health.

•
Having practical experience with Python or R and the ability to work with structured and complex datasets; familiarity with Power BI, digital health technologies or digital biomarkers is an advantage.

•
Being analytical, curious and proactive, with the confidence to ask questions, critically review scientific evidence, communicate findings clearly and collaborate across disciplines.

•
Communicating fluently in English.

•
Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

•
Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

•
Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

•
Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

•
Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Data di inizio: febbraio 2027 o agosto 2027, flessibile

Essere una forza per il bene e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario

In qualità di R&D Intern in Clinical Digital Transformation presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è di aiutare ad accelerare l'uso delle tecnologie di salute digitale, dei dati e dell'automazione nella ricerca clinica. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con scienziati, professionisti della ricerca clinica, specialisti dei dati e team operativi per valutare le soluzioni digitali, analizzare e visualizzare i dati digitali o clinici e ottimizzare i processi di ricerca clinica. Questa è la vostra opportunità di fare un impatto mentre guadagnando le mani su esperienza e mentorship per iniziare la vostra carriera.

Come farai un impatto come Interno R&D nella Trasformazione Digitale Clinica

•
Valutare le tecnologie sanitarie digitali, inclusi gli indossabili e i sensori, per determinare la loro validità scientifica, le prestazioni di misura, l'usabilità e l'idoneità per gli studi clinici.

•
Valutazione della letteratura scientifica e tecnica relativa alle misure digitali, validazione, usabilità e test operativi dei dispositivi digitali.

•
Analizzando i dataset clinici e digitali per identificare i modelli, valutare la qualità dei dati e tradurre i risultati in chiare visualizzazioni, dashboard e intuizioni attuabili.

•
Identificare le opportunità per automatizzare le attività ripetitive e migliorare i flussi di lavoro di elaborazione dei dati attraverso i processi di ricerca clinica.

•
Sostenere la diffusione della tecnologia digitale negli studi clinici, dai protocolli e dai questionari ai test, alla segnalazione e alle raccomandazioni per i team scientifici e operativi.

Che cosa vi farà successo

•
Essendo uno studente attuale o fresco laureato in ingegneria delle scienze della vita o un campo correlato.

•
Portare un forte interesse nell'applicazione delle tecnologie digitali e della scienza dei dati alla ricerca clinica e alla salute.

•
Avere esperienza pratica con Python o R e la capacità di lavorare con dataset strutturati e complessi; la familiarità con Power BI, tecnologie per la salute digitale o biomarcatori digitali è un vantaggio.

•
Essendo analitico, curioso e proattivo, con la fiducia di porre domande, rivedere criticamente le prove scientifiche, comunicare i risultati chiaramente e collaborare attraverso le discipline.

•
Comunicare fluentemente in inglese.

•
Dimostrando coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

•
Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

•
Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

•
Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

•
Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che un forte elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto per iniziare il tuo viaggio di carriera con noi?

Applicare ora e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario.

Seien Sie eine Kraft für das Gute und verwandeln Sie Ihr Potenzial in etwas Außergewöhnliches

Als R&D Intern in Clinical Digital Transformation bei Nestlé Research ist es Ihre Mission, den Einsatz digitaler Gesundheitstechnologien, Daten und Automatisierung in der klinischen Forschung zu beschleunigen. Sie arbeiten eng mit Wissenschaftlern, Fachleuten der klinischen Forschung, Datenspezialisten und operativen Teams zusammen, um digitale Lösungen zu bewerten, digitale oder klinische Daten zu analysieren und zu visualisieren und klinische Forschungsprozesse zu optimieren. Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, etwas zu bewirken und gleichzeitig Erfahrung und Mentorenschaft zu sammeln, um Ihre Karriere anzukurbeln.

Wie Sie als R & D Praktikant in der klinischen digitalen Transformation etwas bewirken können

•
Bewertung digitaler Gesundheitstechnologien, einschließlich Wearables und Sensoren, zur Bestimmung ihrer wissenschaftlichen Validität, Messleistung, Nutzbarkeit und Eignung für klinische Studien.

•
Überprüfung der wissenschaftlichen und technischen Literatur zu digitalen Maßnahmen, Validierung, Nutzbarkeit und Betriebsprüfung digitaler Geräte.

•
Analyse klinischer und digitaler Datensätze, um Muster zu identifizieren, die Datenqualität zu bewerten und Ergebnisse in klare Visualisierungen, Dashboards und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen.

•
Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten, sich wiederholende Aktivitäten zu automatisieren und die Arbeitsabläufe der Datenverarbeitung in klinischen Forschungsprozessen zu verbessern.

•
Unterstützung des Einsatzes digitaler Technologien in klinischen Studien, von Protokollen und Fragebögen bis hin zu Tests, Berichten und Empfehlungen für wissenschaftliche und operative Teams.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

•
Als aktueller Student oder frischer Absolvent in Life Sciences Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich.

•
Ein starkes Interesse an der Anwendung digitaler Technologien und Data Science in der klinischen Forschung und Gesundheit.

•
Praktische Erfahrung mit Python oder R und die Fähigkeit, mit strukturierten und komplexen Datensätzen zu arbeiten; die Vertrautheit mit Power BI, digitalen Gesundheitstechnologien oder digitalen Biomarkern ist von Vorteil.

•
Analytisch, neugierig und proaktiv sein, mit dem Vertrauen, Fragen zu stellen, wissenschaftliche Beweise kritisch zu überprüfen, Erkenntnisse klar zu kommunizieren und disziplinübergreifend zusammenzuarbeiten.

•
fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren.

•
Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für bürobasierte Rollen)

Soyez une force pour le bien et transformez votre potentiel en quelque chose d'extraordinaire

En tant que stagiaire en R-D en transformation numérique clinique à Nestlé Research, votre mission est d'accélérer l'utilisation des technologies de santé numérique, des données et de l'automatisation dans la recherche clinique. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les scientifiques, les professionnels de la recherche clinique, les spécialistes des données et les équipes opérationnelles pour évaluer les solutions numériques, analyser et visualiser les données numériques ou cliniques et optimiser les processus de recherche clinique. Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que stagiaire en R-D en transformation numérique clinique

•
Évaluer les technologies numériques de la santé, y compris les appareils portables et les capteurs, afin de déterminer leur validité scientifique, leur performance en matière de mesure, leur facilité d'utilisation et leur aptitude aux études cliniques.

•
Examen de la littérature scientifique et technique relative aux mesures numériques, à la validation, à la facilité d'utilisation et aux essais opérationnels des appareils numériques.

•
Analyser les ensembles de données cliniques et numériques afin d'identifier les modèles, d'évaluer la qualité des données et de traduire les résultats en visualisations claires, en tableaux de bord et en idées exploitables.

•
Identifier les possibilités d'automatiser les activités répétitives et améliorer les flux de travail liés au traitement des données dans les processus de recherche clinique.

•
Appuyer le déploiement de la technologie numérique dans les études cliniques, depuis les protocoles et les questionnaires jusqu'aux essais, rapports et recommandations à l'intention des équipes scientifiques et opérationnelles.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

•
Être un étudiant actuel ou un nouveau diplômé en génie des sciences de la vie ou un domaine connexe.

•
Apporter un vif intérêt à l'application des technologies numériques et de la science des données à la recherche clinique et à la santé.

•
Avoir une expérience pratique avec Python ou R et la capacité de travailler avec des ensembles de données structurés et complexes; la connaissance de Power BI, des technologies de santé numériques ou des biomarqueurs numériques est un avantage.

•
Être analytique, curieux et proactif, avec la confiance de poser des questions, examiner critiquement les preuves scientifiques, communiquer les résultats clairement et collaborer entre les disciplines.

•
Communiquer couramment en anglais.

•
Démontrer le courage, la collaboration, la rapidité et l'apprentissage continu, tout en traduisant les idées en un impact mesurable et en créant une valeur partagée.

À Nestlé Research, nous mettons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As a Food & Beverage and Event Intern at Nestlé Research, your mission is to support outstanding daily hospitality operations and help deliver seamless, memorable events. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with the Food & Beverage Manager, Event Coordinator, restaurant and event teams, and guest-facing colleagues. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands-on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a Food & Beverage and Event Intern

• Coordinating event logistics, guest communication and on-site support to help deliver smooth, welcoming experiences.

• Analyzing operational data and presenting clear insights that support informed decisions and service improvements.

• Developing fresh ideas and practical concepts that enhance food, beverage and event offerings.

• Partnering across teams to solve unexpected challenges, prioritize tasks and keep operations running smoothly.

• Supporting daily restaurant and hospitality operations while anticipating guest and team needs.

What will make you successful

• Current student or recent graduate (Bachelor or Master) in hospitality, F&B, or a related field

• Prior hands-on exposure to food and beverage service, guest-facing operations or event support

• Being organized, reliable and attentive, with the confidence to adapt quickly and contribute in a fast-paced environment.

• Having strong customer service, communication and analytical skills, together with curiosity and a proactive approach to learning.

• Communicating fluently in French; English is an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Digital Food Safety Early Warning Associate Specialist at Nestlé Research, your mission is to enable the proactive detection of potential food safety issues by strengthening the evaluation of external scientific signals and the evolution of digital early warning systems.. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with food safety, quality, research, technology, and external data partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Food Safety Early Warning Associate Specialist

• Strengthening proactive food safety early warning by scouting and evaluating emerging issues across priority contaminant areas.

• Identifying and assessing internal and external data sources that improve the detection, prioritization, and scientific evaluation of early signals.

• Contribute to the evaluation and deployment of digital technologies that enhance data-driven detection of emerging food safety topics.

• Testing prototypes that help transform early warning processes into scalable digital solutions.

• Participate in scientific collaborations that connect research, technology, and business needs to protect consumers.

• Delivering project activities with focus, rigor, and follow-through to support impactful food safety decisions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing basic chemistry knowledge and a good understanding of chemical contaminants, including how they can emerge, evolve, and impact food safety.

• Applying knowledge of food safety and quality processes in the context of supply chains, incident occurrence, issue evolution, and potential consumer impact.

• Using data and digital technologies in a food safety context, ideally to support data-driven risk assessment, root-cause analysis, and early warning decision-making.

• Collaborating effectively with diverse internal and external partners, while translating research into practical business impact.

• Communicating fluently in English; working proficiency in French is a plus.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.
